arms: Three prespecified seeds × [independent with READ or independently refitted without READ] × [raw contextual free features KEEP, GRU(8) KEEP and BP, fixed, ordinary learned, analytic QVI and external finite-obstacle physical readouts KEEP and BP] = 66. Each family uses identical normalized causal state and conditional ridge-SVD with unbiased intercept. Physical channels enter alongside raw state. GRU parameters are trained with the same profiled objective and budget. No weight edits beyond BP.
state: Current x, cumulative running x mean, both free class scores, signed and absolute margin, first margin difference, accumulated mean absolute margin, elapsed time and six prefix indicators. All are available when acting. Time origin is first completed prefix. Source, group, correct class, purchased scores and future observations are excluded from state. Use original FP64 #6958 finite flow with #6739 regenerative nominal/implicit threshold and fixed absolute reset.
teacher: Source/creator connected components assigned to at most five deterministic class-stratified whole-component folds; require at least two. Nested least-squares Monte Carlo. To train a WAIT value at any prefix, take the actual later path under a policy trained without this source component, excluding its entire fold at every subsequent date, including model calibration. Regress the realized discounted return of that policy on the current free state. Terminal WAIT is masked; dummy target equals STOP. Empty-fold fallback uses equal half-correct prior with actual paid cost and its continuation action. No maximum of realized future outcomes. Ridge nuisance .08, source-macro standardized features and weights. Source-held-out additive residual calibration, shrunk toward zero with four independent-group pseudocounts. Source-excluded forecasts on TRAIN drive the external boundary; full TRAIN forecaster deploys unchanged on other sets. NoREAD never uses paid hit labels in optimization.
boundary: External b = nominal + 0.9 * minimum distance to the supported absolute reset limits * tanh(max allowed terminating Q minus Q_WAIT). Final prefix forces maximal positive displacement. The physical mapping is chosen monotone. The finite learned task value and analytic internal frozen-drift optimum address separate objectives.
training: Full source-balanced actual immediate STOP/READ supervision, source-held-out realized continuation target; plain and all contextual/physical readouts use same 0.001 centered ridge. Physical or GRU BP gets four profiled projected Adam steps, learning rate .075, L2 displacement <=.35. Development picks best macro utility subject to worst RETAIN group >=-.05 vs same incumbent; ties within 1e-12 retain earlier attempt. Compare post-selection READ masking and independently refitted dynamic noREAD. Paid probability calibration is descriptive; report predicted and observed READ-minus-STOP dollars in fixed intervals on evaluation sets.
timing: For each arm lock the strongest of immediate free, immediate paid (when legal), and same learned conditional STOP/READ at first prefix on DEV. Tie order conditional,free,paid. Report full vs immediate free, this locked immediate control, independently fitted dynamic noREAD, and matched same-score noREAD. A positive paid timing attribution also requires actual READs and WAITs with positive mean gains vs independently fitted noREAD and chosen immediate. Primary capability gate follows parent protocol; stronger mechanism attribution is separate.
resources: Cold worker per availability and seed, 11 sequential arms inside each worker. Per-arm marginal wall and process CPU plus per-candidate solver/backward/eval; prepare and cold grouped wall/child process CPU receipts separately. Full fit/source seal must pass before confirmation worker reads TEST. Frontend selection and opportunity gate controlled by parent protocol. No formal TEST queries used to design or repair this implementation.
source_uncertainty: For each of the two paired policy contrasts report exact one-sided group sign P with ties counted as non-wins, Bonferroni .025 each. Joint gate requires absolute gate and positively realized paid timing supported on both contrasts, all three seeds; do not interpret the exploratory 11-family set as multiplicity-corrected.
